name: houserx-site-audit
description: Automated audit of houserx.com: SEO, accessibility, links, content hygiene, mobile layout, lead form

scripts.test:visual: docker run --rm --ipc=host -e BASE_URL -v "$PWD":/work -v /work/node_modules -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.0-noble bash -c 'npm ci --silent && npx playwright test tests/visual'
scripts.test:visual:update: docker run --rm --ipc=host -e BASE_URL -v "$PWD":/work -v /work/node_modules -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.0-noble bash -c 'npm ci --silent && npx playwright test tests/visual --update-snapshots'
